best_for: People juggling WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, Slack and Instagram DMs on one computer who are tired of switching between five apps, and who use five accounts or fewer.

points.title: 19 chat networks in one inbox
points.text: Beeper connects WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Google Messages, Google Chat, Google Voice, LINE, Viber, WeChat, Snapchat, Reddit, GroupMe, Tumblr and iMessage. Replies go out through each network, so contacts do not need Beeper.

points.title: iMessage on Mac only
points.text: The iMessage connection works only on macOS. Windows users of this download can reach the other networks but not iMessage. Snapchat and username-only Signal accounts need Beeper's cloud connection rather than an on-device one.

points.title: Free up to five accounts
points.text: The free tier covers up to 5 connected accounts. Beeper Plus is USD 9.99 per month after a 7-day trial and raises that to 10 accounts, 3 per network, with send later, reminders, incognito mode and voice note transcription. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Where your messages travel
points.text: With on-device connections, messages go straight from your computer to each network and keep end-to-end encryption where the network has it. The older cloud connections run through Beeper's servers, with stored history encrypted so Beeper cannot read it. You need a Beeper account either way.

points.title: Old chats may not all come across
points.text: History import varies by network. Signal and iMessage on Mac bring in everything, but Telegram and Slack start with 50 messages per chat, LinkedIn with 10 recent conversations, and WhatsApp usually about a year. Older messages may stay only in the original app.

points.title: Versions kept on this site
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 101 versions of the 64-bit installer, which installs for the current user only. macOS has Intel and Apple Silicon builds for macOS 13 or later, but lists only the current release. Beeper also makes Linux, iPhone and Android apps, which are not listed here.
